==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
There is a glittering sparkling orb flying around in the sky. It is a source of magical power. I want it, but it is out of my reach.

I am approached by someone in a business suit with a briefcase. They have a contract with them. They say that if I sign, that I can have the magic orb.

I sign the contract. People around me question why I would agree to the terms so quickly. I feel confident that I made the right choice, and that the power will soon be mine.
